name: Agent gateway smoke
command:
set -euo pipefail
email=$(awk -F= '/^BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=/{print substr($0,index($0,"=")+1)}' backend/.env | tr -d '"' | tail -1)
password=$(awk -F= '/^BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=/{print substr($0,index($0,"=")+1)}' backend/.env | tr -d '"' | tail -1)
cookie=$(mktemp); body=$(mktemp); me=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$cookie" "$body" "$me"' EXIT
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -c "$cookie" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$(printf '{"email":"%s","password":"%s"}' "$email" "$password")" http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/User/login > "$me"
chat_status=$(curl -sS -o "$body" -w '%{http_code}' -b "$cookie" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"conversation_id":"smoke-policy-1","user_message":"Qual é a política de check-in?","channel":"web","locale":"pt-BR","metadata":{}}' http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/agent/chat)
node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({login_status:fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],"utf8"),chat_status:process.argv[3],action:x.action?.type ?? null,action_status:x.action?.status ?? null,intent:x.intent ?? null}))' "$body" "$me" "$chat_status"
description: Verify the correct authenticated chat contract through the backend agent gateway.
